name: hallmark
tagline_zh: 新页面总像模板？截图丢进来，拆解它的设计基因，再给你一套不像AI做的方案——连字体间距都有人味。
tagline_en: Tired of AI-look pages? Drop a URL or screenshot, get a human-feel design audit and rebuild—down to type and.
desc_en: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots. Use when the user asks to build a new app or landing page, wants to redesign something, invokes Hallmark by name, or uses audit/redesign/study.
why_zh: 它不堆建议，而是从真实页面提取设计系统，再按你的场景重混，所以结果有出处、有逻辑，不是空泛的“更好看”。
why_en: It extracts a real design system from any URL or image, then remixes it for your context—so every choice has provenance, not.
